messages:
mike: Heads-up — ops asked how our rolling canary should behave when region capacity trims a tenant's exposure. Should fallback preserve the same tenant-level % or drain them to baseline?

lina: tl;dr: we can't silently reduce a tenant's canary exposure below their entitlement. Need explicit rollback or notify + automatic fallback to a compatible variant.

joel: agree with Lina. If region X is starved, fallback should route to cheaper variant in another region only if the tenant's SLA allows cross-region. otherwise failover to local baseline model.

anna: UX concern — product needs visibility. In the console we'd show `exposure_target`, `current_exposure`, `fallback_reason`. If we auto-reduce exposure we must surface why and who approved.

ian: for telemetry, we need two new metrics: `canary_exposure.override_count` (per-tenant) and `fallback.routed_variant` (labels: region, variant, reason). also a histogram for `canary_latency.delta` when fallback happens.

mike: proposal for routing policy schema (draft):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  scope: tenant|region|global
  exposure_target_pct: 5
  fallback:
    allowed_variants: [v1-quant, v1-int8, v1-legacy]
    cross_region_allowed: false
    preserve_exposure_on_capacity_loss: true
```
joeL: nit: keep `preserve_exposure_on_capacity_loss` boolean, but we should have `notify_on_auto_reduce: true` too. ops needs an automatic page if we reduce canary for an SLA tenant.

lina: Also let's add `quota_guardrails` — if tenant has reserved throughput, we shouldn't pull capacity for canary unless explicit opt-in.

mike: Good catch. Two API changes: 1) internal assigner must be aware of `exposure_target_pct` as a soft target, and 2) a deterministic tie-breaker when capacity < target to decide which tenant slices get reduced.

joel: For tie-breaker, suggest: sort by (entitlement_level desc, current_active_sessions desc, random_seed). Keep deterministic per-minute window.

anna: Console UX: add per-tenant timeline showing planned vs actual exposure with hover to show `fallback_event` details. Also a quick rollback button on the tenant view.

ian: Implementation checklist for telemetry: export `exposure_intent` (what we wanted), `exposure_actual`, `fallback_events[]` with fields `from_variant -> to_variant`, `reason`, `region`, `capacity_snapshot`. All aggregated to Grafana dashes.

mike: @deploy-bot can we add a small experiment: enable `preserve_exposure_on_capacity_loss=false` for a single lab tenant for 1h to collect behavior? need monitoring and an instant rollback.

deploy-bot: schedule accepted — will deploy lab toggle to `tenant:lab-alpha` at 2065001330, auto-rollback at 2065004930 unless manually extended. :robot_face:

joel: One more ops safety item: if fallback crosses region, ensure logs include `data_plane_region_flag` and double-check compliance owners.

lina: action items: mike update routing schema, ian add telemetry metrics, anna design tenant UX panel, joel draft ops runbook for cross-region fallback. I'll sync infra next week to validate capacity signals.

mike: Thanks — i'll send a PR with schema + assigners changes and ping for reviews.

anna: :thumbsup:
